_source: Doc-derived, not recorded: Granola's public API needs a Business-plan grn_ key that this repo does not hold. Every field and value comes from the published OpenAPI examples for GET /v1/notes/{note_id}/transcript — https://docs.granola.ai/api-reference/openapi.json and https://docs.granola.ai/api-reference/get-transcript. The macos_* pages carry the macOS speaker shape (source + attribution); ios_page carries the iOS shape (diarization_label, no attribution). Re-record against a real key when one exists.
